summary: Mercy petition delay beyond 8 years; contention of inordinate delay for commutation of death sentence; SGPC filed petition on petitioner's behalf; no personal mercy petition from petitioner; co-accused appeals pending; standard: death sentence commutation due to prolonged delay; reliance on Shatrughan Chauhan; procedural lapse in mercy consideration; final order: commutation not granted due to lack of personal petition and pending appeals.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; no commutation granted due to absence of personal mercy petition and pendency of co-accused appeals.
